pages.title: Coronation
pages.text: Peony · Flower Drink$(br2)Brewed from the Peony Tea Bag in a teapot with water; yields twelve cups.$(br2)$(br2)Gold is the sweat of the sun.$(br2)— Inca saying

pages.title: Effect
pages.text: Grants Luck, villagers revere you, with gold particles.$(br2)$(br2)Luck 3:00, Hero of the Village 1:00
